Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.

Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Sobre a vaga

Na OceanPact, acreditamos que o desenvolvimento das pessoas é um dos motores para construirmos um futuro sustentável. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Analista Pl. para fortalecer nossa área de Desenvolvimento Humano Organizacional .

Essa posição terá papel estratégico por conduzir e apoiar o ciclo de gestão de performance , contribuindo para que líderes e colaboradores tenham clareza de metas, feedbacks estruturados e oportunidades de crescimento.

Se você tem paixão por desenvolver pessoas, promover cultura de alta performance e traduzir estratégias em entregas consistentes , essa é a oportunidade de fazer parte de uma empresa que cresce com propósito e inovação.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir programas de gestão de performance (avaliação de desempenho, PDI, Conversas de carreira) apoiando estratégias de desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da área e transformar dados em recomendações estratégicas.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros de treinamento, assegurando qualidade e inovação nas soluções.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento, aplicação e melhoria contínua dos sistemas de avaliação de desempenho, incluindo metodologias como 9Box, avaliação por competências e metas.

Requisitos

Obrigatórios:

  • Formação em Psicologia, Pedagogia, Administração, Recursos Humanos e afins.
  • Experiência prévia com Desenvolvimento Humano Organizacional, principalmente com programas de carreira e performance.
  • Experiência com Gestão de Projetos, desde o momento do diagnóstico junto ao cliente até a entrega de relatórios executivos.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de avaliação e performance.

Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou certificações na área de Desenvolvimento Humano e Liderança.
  • Experiência com ciclos de Gestão de Performance.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de aprendizagem e metodologias de gestão de projetos.

Local de trabalho

  • Glória, Rio de Janeiro/RJ
  • Modalidade: presencial

O que buscamos

Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério
  • Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares
  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação
  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore

  • Garantir excelência técnica em UI/UX, performance de front-end, acessibilidade, SEO técnico e experiência do usuário;
  • Ser referência em integrações com APIs internas e externas, contratos, versionamento, segurança e governança;

  • Identificar riscos técnicos, gargalos de performance e dívidas técnicas, propondo planos estruturados de evolução contínua;
  • Liderar discussões técnicas, revisões de arquitetura e code reviews avançados;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e elevação da maturidade técnica do time;

Requisitos e qualificações

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial

  • Domínio de JavaScript e TypeScript;
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura de aplicações web, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Vivência com versionamento (Git), code review e estratégias de branch;

Would you enjoy working at the intersection of finance, operations and commercial performance across Latin America?

Would you like to apply your analytical skills to drive visibility, discipline and decision‑making in a dynamic global organization?

Join our SP&S Finance Team!

At Baker Hughes, our Subsea Products and Services (SP&S) organization delivers advanced equipment, systems and services that support safe, reliable and efficient subsea operations. Our Finance team plays a critical role in enabling performance transparency, disciplined execution and value creation across regions and business segments.

Partner with the best!

As an FP&A Finance Experienced Professional, you will support financial planning, analysis and execution activities across SP&S LATAM. Working closely with the LATAM Finance Manager and regional stakeholders, you will provide insight into operational and commercial performance while supporting close cycles, audits, bids, and planning processes. This role requires strong analytical capability, ownership mindset, and the ability to collaborate across functions and geographies.

Responsibilities

  • Partnering with the SP&S LATAM Finance Manager to provide detailed financial analysis, execution support and visibility across operational and commercial performance topics.
  • Performing detailed analysis of OVC and COQ to identify outliers, anomalies and cost trends, summarizing findings to support management reviews and decision‑making.
  • Supporting operational and process improvement initiatives by quantifying financial impacts, tracking execution results and delivering analytical insights to leadership.

Close, Ledger & Reporting Activities

  • Supporting ledger reviews and reconciliations in coordination with Finance Leaders and Regional teams, ensuring accuracy and escalating challenges as needed.
  • Providing ongoing ledger visibility for Mexico and Colombia, including preparation of P&L and balance movement summaries for monthly and quarterly close.
  • Leading monthly and quarterly close activities for Mexico and Brazil, preparing variance analysis, execution commentary and supporting schedules to ensure accuracy, completeness and timeliness.
  • Supporting internal and external audit requests through data preparation, documentation and variance explanations.

Planning, Forecasting & Decision Support

  • Contributing analytical support to financial planning and review cycles such as Annual Plan (AP), MRP, Operating Plans and Long‑Range Planning (LRP).
  • Preparing inputs focused on operational drivers, cost performance and execution assumptions.
  • Preparing financial materials, analysis and ad‑hoc requests to support HQ, Area Leaders and Regional Finance teams, ensuring alignment with leadership guidance.

Commercial & Bid Support

  • Supporting bid elaboration for LATAM projects outside Brazil, primarily Mexico, working cross‑functionally to ensure robust cost estimates and budgets are developed.

Collaboration & Finance Governance

  • Maintaining close alignment with the FP&A Manager, escalating risks, issues and emerging trends, and supporting consistent messaging and financial interpretation across stakeholders.
  • Actively participating in and promoting Baker Hughes behaviors, values and wellbeing initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Have a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
  • Have a minimum of 2 years of experience within a Finance function, preferably in FP&A or Controllership.
  • Have fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong oral and written communication skills combined with strong interpersonal effectiveness.
  • Ability to influence others and work effectively with cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience leading initiatives of moderate scope and impact.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple activities and priorities simultaneously.
  • Effective problem identification and solution mindset.
  • Proven analytical rigor and organizational skills.

Work Pattern

  • On‑site in our RETIC base, located in Ilha do Fundão, RJ.
  • Working hours: from 7am‑4pm or 8am‑5pm

Benefits

  • Contemporary work‑life balance policies and wellbeing programs.
  • Comprehensive private medical care options.
  • Life insurance and disability coverage.
  • Tailored financial programs.
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Finance Experienced Professional - FP&A Operations.

Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Venha crescer com a Cardway

Na Cardway, acreditamos que conexões bem construídas movem negócios e transformam trajetórias.

Se você busca um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico e com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento, e quer fazer parte de um time que constrói resultados juntos, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade.

Sobre a Cardway

A Cardway é uma empresa brasileira de meios de pagamento e soluções digitais, formada a partir da união entre o Grupocard e a Movilway, duas referências no mercado que somam décadas de expertise e inovação no setor.

Atuamos com um portfólio completo e integrado de soluções que reúne meios de pagamento, telecom, serviços digitais, mobilidade urbana, serviços bancários e a plataforma CardHub, conectando tudo em um único ecossistema para nossos parceiros.

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Nossa cultura é guiada por valores que orientam nossas decisões:

  • Compromisso com Parceiros e Clientes
  • Transparência
  • Excelência na Prática
  • Colaboração
  • Responsabilidade

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem quando as pessoas se sentem parte e trabalham juntas em um ambiente ético, colaborativo e bem estruturado.

  • Atualizar cadastros e controlar o estoque com atenção e responsabilidade.

Local de Atuação: Itaboraí, Rio Bonito e Tanguá/RJ

Para esta posição, buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e construir relacionamentos de confiança com nossos parceiros.

  • CNH válida (categoria B)

Além de um pacote de benefícios completo, você também terá acesso à Uniway, nossa plataforma de educação corporativa, com cursos e treinamentos para apoiar seu crescimento.

Diversidade

Diversidade importa (e muito!)

Esta vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

title: Legal Billing & Operations Analyst - Asset Resolution
description:
About World Business Lenders

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides short-term, real estate‑collateralized commercial loans to small and medium‑sized businesses across the United States that do not have access to traditional financing. The company also services its own loan portfolio and those of third parties, with a focus on managing non‑performing loan pools and REO.

WBL is a U.S.‑based company with a fully remote workforce. Working hours are 9:00 am–6:00 pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. The role requires strong spoken and written English. All resumes must be submitted in English.

Overview

Establish reliable tracking of all Asset Resolution invoices; improve organization and follow‑up on current invoices so eligible discounts are not missed; support timely movement of invoices through review, correction, and payment readiness; provide strong operational support for aged invoice matters handled by Cristina; improve visibility into invoice status, blockers, and upcoming payment items; and help create a more consistent, disciplined legal billing workflow between Legal Operations, Finance, and outside counsel.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

  • Manage legal billing workflow for Asset Resolution matters
  • Track invoice status, rejections, corrections, and payment readiness
  • Coordinate with outside counsel, Legal, Finance, and AP
  • Support timely processing of current invoices within discount periods
  • Assist Corporate VP with aged invoice negotiation support and follow‑up
  • Maintain accurate reporting, records, and billing trackers

Requirements

  • Education: Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Operations, or a related field
  • Not less than 5 years of experience
  • Experience managing invoice or billing workflows in a structured, high‑volume environment
  • Hands‑on experience tracking, processing, and resolving invoices (including rejections and corrections)
  • Comfortable coordinating across multiple stakeholders (Legal, Finance, AP, and external counsel/vendors)
  • Strong ability to ensure invoices move through payment cycles on time, including discount deadlines
  • Experience maintaining accurate trackers, records, and status reporting for financial or operational workflows
  • Strong Excel skills and familiarity with workflow tools (e.g., Monday.com or similar systems)
  • Highly organized with strong follow‑through on tasks and escalations
  • Able to work in deadline‑driven, process‑heavy environments with repetitive but detail‑critical work
  • Strong communication skills for ongoing follow‑ups and coordination across teams

Preferred Background / Industry Experience

  • Experience in legal billing, legal operations, or law firm billing in a financial services.
  • Candidates coming from law firms, in‑house legal departments, vendor management teams, or finance‑adjacent operational roles with substantial exposure to outside counsel billing and invoice workflow management will be viewed favorably.
  • Experience handling high‑volume invoice tracking, rejected invoice resolution, payment‑cycle coordination, discount‑period monitoring, and support for aged invoice reconciliation is strongly preferred.

Specific Technical Skills Needed

  • Strong proficiency in Excel and Monday.com; experience with invoice tracking, billing reports, document management, and workflow systems; ability to maintain accurate records, monitor discount and payment deadlines, and support billing coordination across Legal, Finance, and AP.

Specific Soft Skills Needed

  • Strong communication
  • Multitasking and organization
  • Attention to detail and follow‑through
  • Professionalism and cross‑functional collaboration
  • Time management, and problem‑solving

Benefits

  • Enjoy Paid Time Off (PTO) to recharge
  • Salary paid in USD
  • Work comfortably 100% from home

  • Configure and maintain monitoring setups using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and set up alerts for key health and performance metrics to keep applications and platforms observable, reliable, and cost-effective.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents affecting containerized workloads, including networking, identity, configurations, or performance across the Azure platform.
  • Analyze resource usage and Azure cost data to spot optimization opportunities, such as right-sizing resources, adjusting scaling policies, optimizing images, or selecting the best services for the job.

Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver ações intersetoriais, mantendo a integração com a rede de suporte social, fortalecendo e implementando as ações na comunidade;

Utilizar instrumentos validados para rastreio e acompanhamento, como o Perfil Sensorial 2, SPM (Sensory Processing Measure), e escalas de desenvolvimento (Bayley, Denver II) ou específicas para TEA (como auxílio no fechamento de diagnóstico via ADOS-2 ou CARS).

Analisar o desempenho em Atividades de Vida Diária (AVDs) — como comer, vestir-se e tomar banho — e Atividades Instrumentais (AIVDs).

Avaliar hiper ou hiporreatividade tátil, auditiva, visual, vestibular e proprioceptiva que impactam o comportamento e a aprendizagem.

Planejar e executar sessões baseadas na Teoria de Integração Sensorial de Ayres, utilizando equipamentos suspensos e estímulos controlados para organizar o sistema nervoso central do paciente.

Criar estratégias (uso de pistas visuais, encadeamento de tarefas) para que o paciente ganhe autonomia em higiene, alimentação e vestuário.

Realizar em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional o Manejo da Seletividade Alimentar

Promover o Desenvolvimento de Habilidades Motoras focando na motricidade fina (preensão para escrita, uso de tesoura) e coordenação óculo-manual.

Prescrever e confeccionar recursos de Tecnologia Assistiva.

Orientar a família e a escola sobre como organizar o ambiente para reduzir a sobrecarga sensorial (ajuste de iluminação, redução de ruídos, zonas de calma).

Realizar o acolhimento e a orientação parental, ajudando os cuidadores a compreenderem o processamento sensorial do filho e a aplicar estratégias de manejo em casa.

Elaborar relatórios detalhados para o Plano de Atendimento Individualizado (PAI) ou Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) nas escolas, sugerindo adaptações curriculares e ambientais.

Emitir pareceres técnicos para fins de direitos (como o BPC ou solicitações judiciais para planos de saúde/SUS).

Realizar atendimentos e visitas domiciliares compartilhados com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional.

Elaborar projetos terapêuticos singulares em conjunto com profissionais da equipe multiprofissional, desenvolvendo a responsabilidade compartilhada.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Especialização completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Neurofuncional, Traumato-ortopedica, Estratégia Saúde da Família, Saúde Pública ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Terapeuta Ocupacional.

Informações adicionais

Local: Irajá

Horário de Trabalho: 20h semanais

Sobre a empresa:

Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso.
Liderança. Confiança. Expertise.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver projetos de engenharia, planejar, orçar e contratar empresas ao conduzir a operação e manutenção de equipamentos médico-hospitalares, visando o funcionamento e bom desempenho dos equipamentos e máquinas, bem como acompanhar a reparação e reposição dos mesmos. Participar no processo de aquisição, recebimento, testes, treinamento e alienação dos equipamentos. Controlar suprimentos, serviços contratados e executados, assim como elaborar documentação técnica e realizar visitas técnicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia (Clínica, Biomédica, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas).
  • Registro ativo no CREA.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em Engenharia Clínica ou Gestão de Tecnologias em Saúde.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses na função.

We are hiring a Consultant – CFD & Process Safety to join our Risk & Safety team in Brazil.

This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and Process Safety who is looking to grow in a consulting environment and work on meaningful technical challenges with real client impact.

You will contribute to projects across the energy sector, supporting both conventional and energy transition markets, and work alongside experienced professionals in Brazil and globally.

Why the role matters

Our team supports clients in improving the safety, reliability, and resilience of their assets and operations. We work across a broad range of projects, helping clients make informed engineering and operational decisions through high-quality technical analysis.

This role matters because it offers the opportunity to apply technical skills to real-world safety challenges while building experience in a client-facing consulting environment.

What you will work on

In this role, you will support the delivery of a range of technical safety and risk studies, including:

  • Fire and explosion modelling
  • Flare radiation analysis
  • Helideck turbulence studies
  • Process safety studies such as HAZOP, HAZID, LOPA, Bow‑Tie, Safety Case, and EERA

You will also work closely with project teams to prepare technical deliverables, contribute to project execution, and support discussions with clients and colleagues across different offices.

What we are looking for

We are looking for professionals with:

  • Degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Relevant experience in CFD and/or Process Safety
  • Experience in studies related to fire, explosion, dispersion, and detection
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English
  • Strong technical writing, communication, and analytical skills
  • The ability to work in a structured, collaborative, and technically demanding environment

What will make you stand out

The following experience will be considered an advantage:

  • Experience with FLACS, KFX, Ansys Fluent, or Ansys CFX
  • M.Sc. or postgraduate qualification in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Process Safety, Fluid Mechanics, Thermal Sciences, or a related engineering discipline
  • Familiarity with Brazilian regulatory and industry requirements
  • Experience with QRA, PHAST, SAFETI , or related tools
  • Knowledge of Python, VBA, or other automation tools

We also value professionals who demonstrate curiosity, sound engineering judgment, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in developing their technical capability.

This is an opportunity to be part of a respected technical team working on challenging engineering problems with real impact.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • work on technically demanding projects,
  • develop your expertise in CFD and Process Safety,
  • gain exposure to clients in Brazil and international markets,
  • contribute to both conventional and energy transition sectors, and
  • grow within a collaborative consulting environment.

If you are looking for a role where you can strengthen your technical capability, contribute to meaningful projects, and continue building your career in risk and safety consulting, we would like to hear from you.

title: Human Resources Coordinator(m/f/x) – Brazil – MSF Belgium
description:
Must be willing to travel for work as needed

CONTEXT

MSF has worked in Brazil for over 30 years in a context of deep social inequalities and unequal access to healthcare. Since 2018, MSF Operational Centre Brussels (OCB) has implemented direct operations, initially supporting migrants and refugees, and later expanding to Indigenous health, emergency response, and public health.

In 2026, the programme focuses on the Rio de Janeiro Tuberculosis Prison Project, improving access to TB care for people deprived of liberty, while maintaining engagement in emergency preparedness, advocacy, and institutional collaboration with MSF Brazil and regional referents.

The programme operates within a shared institutional setup with MSF Brazil and Cell 5 (Latin America & Caribbean), requiring strong coordination and compliance with OCB standards. To support this environment, MSF OCB is recruiting a Human Resources Coordinator (HRCo).

As HRCo , you oversee HR strategy and policy implementation across the programme, ensure alignment with operational needs and OCB standards, act as a strategic partner to operations, and are fully accountable for MSF’s employer responsibilities, including legal and compliance matters.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Strategic HR Leadership & Workforce Planning

  • Translate programme priorities (TB Prison Project, emergency preparedness, advocacy) into short-, mid-, and longterm workforce strategies
  • Adapt the Coordination Team structure to a single project programme, clarifying roles, reporting lines, and decision-making
  • Ensure HR systems support the transition from multiple projects (Marajó, Yanomami) to Rio TB Prison Project
  • Anticipate emergency and future staffing needs through scenario planning, surge mechanisms, and training plans

2. Recruitment, Matching & Talent Management

  • Define HR needs and coordinate recruitment and IMS matching in compliance with Brazilian labour law (CLT) and OCB policies
  • Manage a diverse workforce (country-based and mobile staff), including operational constraints such as Portuguese language requirements
  • Analyse the labour market, define recruitment strategies, and identify effective sourcing channels
  • Maintain an emergency pool to ensure rapid mobilisation capacity
  • Promote internal and interprogramme mobility through a programme-specific mobility approach aligned with MSF standards

3. Governance, Compliance & Institutional Coordination

  • Ensure coherent HR governance within a shared institutional setup (OCB, MSF Brazil, Cell 5)
  • Coordinate closely with MSF Brazil on legal matters, audits, payroll, benefits, HR systems, and outsourced services
  • Ensure full compliance of HR policies, contracts, and procedures with Brazilian legislation and MSF standards
  • Guarantee accurate documentation, HR data quality, system use, monthly closing, and HR reporting
  • Define, adapt, and implement local HR policies, SOPs, and guidelines in line with MSF frameworks
  • Oversee induction, training, performance management (PMS), and career development
  • Identify training and development needs, including high potential staff, aligned with future programme priorities
  • Integrate safeguarding, behaviour & ethics, and diversity & inclusion across the HR lifecycle
  • Define and coordinate a fair, competitive, and compliant reward policy

5. Support Operations & People Management

  • Provide HR analysis and workforce planning for the TB Prison Project, including scaleup and technical specialisation
  • Ensure HR operational support during emergencies (recruitment, deployment, contracts, health and safety, administration)
  • Advise on HR aspects of advocacy initiatives, including contractual and legal considerations
  • Coach managers on people management, communication, conflict management, and stress prevention
  • Prevent, detect, and manage conflicts and behavioural issues

6. Team Leadership, Administration & Duty of Care

  • Act as programme-level HR and Administration technical referent
  • Line manage the HR and administration team
  • Ensure structured staff lifecycle processes (briefings, induction, end of assignment, debriefing, knowledge capitalisation)
  • Ensure safe, healthy, and compliant working conditions in coordination with medical and logistics teams

7. Coordination, Representation & Strategic Contribution

  • Contribute actively to Country Coordination Team decision-making and strategic planning
  • Plan, monitor, and report on HR operational and budgetary needs
  • Report on HR indicators to support programme adjustments and strategic decisions
  • Represent MSF with authorities and external stakeholders on HR and administrative matters

Contribute to the long-term alignment and harmonisation of practices between OCB and MSF Brazil.

REQUIREMENTS

Education & Experience

  • Degree in HR management or related administrative studies is mandatory
  • Minimum 3 years of HR management experience with MSF or a similar INGO is mandatory
  • Minimum 6 months of international MSF experience as HR Coordinator is mandatory
  • Experience in mediation and conflict management is mandatory
  • Experience in training, coaching, mentoring, and team supervision is mandatory
  • Experience in emergency contexts is an asset
  • Knowledge of the Brazilian legal framework is an asset
  • Knowledge of MSF OCB internal HR tools is an asset

Languages

Proficiency in English and Portuguese , both written & spoken is mandatory.

CONDITIONS

  • Expected starting date: As soon as possible
  • Location: based in Rio de Janeiro , Brazil
  • Salary according to MSF salary grid
  • The contractual terms, conditions and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate (mobile staff contract if not resident in Brazil, local contract otherwise)
  • Family position possible

Deadline for applications: 26th of April 2026.

MSF values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of disability, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, race, color or ethnic and national origins, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

Marketing Instructor (AI Training)

We\'re looking for experienced marketing educators to help shape how AI understands branding, consumer behavior, and marketing strategy. Your classroom expertise will directly influence the quality and accuracy of AI-generated content used by learners, businesses, and researchers worldwide.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with AI tools, content evaluation workflows, or instructional design

Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs and AI companies
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
  • Contribute to meaningful work that improves how AI teaches and communicates marketing concepts
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

Experiência sólida, perfil proativo, analítico e dinâmico, para atuação no departamento jurídico, com foco prioritário em contencioso judicial e administrativo e em matérias regulatórias.

A posição envolve a condução e o acompanhamento estratégico do contencioso, incluindo a interação com escritórios externos, a análise de riscos e provisões, a elaboração de manifestações, bem como o controle rigoroso de prazos. Abrange ainda a atuação no suporte ao cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias, com especial atenção às demandas perante a SUSEP.

De forma residual, o(a) profissional poderá prestar apoio na análise e elaboração de contratos, na resposta a consultas jurídicas internas e no suporte jurídico a projetos específicos das companhias do Grupo Austral.

Atividades

Atuação no contencioso administrativo e judicial, incluindo:

  • acompanhamento dos processos;
  • interface com escritórios externos;
  • análise jurídica das demandas, riscos envolvidos e cenários processuais;
  • apoio na definição e revisão de estratégias de defesa;
  • acompanhamento e validação de provisões, contingências e valores envolvidos nos processos.

Prestar suporte jurídico em matérias regulatórias (SUSEP), incluindo:

  • regulatórias periódicas e eventuais;

  • suporte na elaboração de respostas a ofícios, consultas e demandas regulatórias;
  • interação com áreas internas para alinhamento regulatório e mitigação de riscos.

Atuar como ponto focal jurídico em temas de contencioso e regulatório, aplicando conhecimento técnico e visão crítica, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos legais e regulatórios da companhia.

De forma residual, prestar apoio em atividades não centrais à posição, tais como:

Você é uma pessoa motivada, com vontade de crescer e construir uma carreira sólida? Busca um ambiente onde seu trabalho é valorizado e seu desenvolvimento profissional é uma prioridade? Então, temos a oportunidade perfeita para você!

Em nossa empresa, valorizamos a dedicação, o comprometimento e o desejo de fazer a diferença. Como vigilante, você não estará apenas protegendo patrimônios; estará também zelando pela segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e visitantes. Sua atuação será fundamental para manter a ordem e a tranquilidade, tornando o ambiente mais seguro para todos.

Em nossa empresa oferecemos, investimos no crescimento dos nossos colaboradores com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira.

Se você está pronto para assumir um papel essencial, onde seu trabalho será valorizado e terá um impacto positivo na segurança e tranquilidade de muitos, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe de vigilantes. Aqui, seu crescimento profissional é nossa prioridade.

Não perca a chance de integrar uma equipe dedicada e crescer em um ambiente que valoriza o seu potencial. Junte-se a nós e comece uma jornada de sucesso como vigilante!

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e contar com o seu talento em nossa equipe.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Garantir a segurança e a proteção do patrimônio, dos colaboradores e dos visitantes, monitorando e prevenindo atividades suspeitas ou ilegais, assegurando a ordem e o cumprimento das normas internas.

  • Realizar rondas periódicas nas instalações para prevenir e detectar sinais de intrusão, roubo, vandalismo ou outras atividades ilegais.
  • Controlar e registrar a entrada e saída de pessoas, veículos e materiais nas dependências dos clientes.
  • Controlar a entrada de visitantes e prestadores de serviços, garantindo que estejam devidamente cadastrados e acompanhados.
  • Identificar e relatar situações de risco ou condições inseguras, tomando ações preventivas para evitar acidentes ou incidentes.
  • Atuar de forma rápida e eficiente em situações de contingência, como incêndios, acidentes ou invasões, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Colaborar com as forças de segurança pública em casos de crimes ou distúrbios.
  • Manter registros precisos de atividades diárias, incidentes, ocorrências e outras informações relevantes.
  • Preencher relatórios de ocorrência e comunicar aos superiores sobre quaisquer incidentes significativos.
  • Oferecer atendimento cordial e profissional aos colaboradores, visitantes e prestadores de serviços, fornecendo informações e orientações quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na organização e controle de eventos internos.

O vigilante é responsável por garantir a segurança e integridade das instalações e pessoas, prevenindo ações criminosas e respondendo prontamente a contingências. Este profissional deve ser atento, proativo e capaz de atuar de forma eficaz em situações de risco.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso de formação de vigilante com reciclagem em dia.

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.

Key Competencies:

  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.

  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degreeis mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

Para atuar nos serviços de saúde e compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital Municipal Evandro Freire – HMEF e Coordenação de Emergência Regional Ilha do Governador – CER ILHA, na função de TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM.

Atribuições do Cargo

  • Conhecer e nortear suas ações de acordo com o Código de Ética da Enfermagem;
  • Seguir e consultar o Manual de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) em sua prática diária;
  • Chegar pontualmente ao setor, devidamente limpo e uniformizado;
  • Realizar a admissão de pacientes na Unidade instituindo todos os cuidados de enfermagem necessários;
  • Realizar cuidados de enfermagem de acordo com plano de cuidados, elaborado pelo enfermeiro;
  • Obedecer à escala de remanejamento de funcionários, sempre que se considerar necessário;
  • Obedecer à escala diária de serviço, elaborada pelo enfermeiro da unidade;
  • Ler o prontuário dos clientes de sua escala, anotando as observações importantes;
  • Passar a visita nos clientes sob sua responsabilidade, avaliando as condições dos mesmos;
  • Observar as solicitações de exames internos e externos;
  • Preparar as medicações e soluções endovenosas segundo prescrição médica e orientação da farmácia;
  • Administrar aos clientes as medicações prescritas, de acordo com as técnicas e os horários estabelecidos;
  • Controlar e monitorar os gotejamentos das soluções;
  • Checar as prescrições médicas e planos de cuidados de enfermagem;
  • Registrar no relatório de enfermagem todos os cuidados prestados, intercorrências e alterações de sinais vitais no decorrer do plantão;
  • Auxiliar no preparo e execução de procedimentos médicos e de enfermagem;
  • Atuar em emergências com os demais elementos da equipe;
  • Manusear equipamentos utilizados na monitorização e tratamento dos pacientes graves (conhecimento básico);
  • Atender às solicitações dos clientes e seus acompanhantes;
  • Recolher a roupa utilizada em hamper próprio;
  • Encaminhar o material sujo ao expurgo da unidade;
  • Checar a sala de equipamentos, mantendo-os conectados nas devidas tomadas;
  • Preparar e acompanhar os clientes aos exames, transferências, centro cirúrgico e sempre que se fizer necessário;
  • Preparar o corpo do cliente após o óbito;
  • Manter o enfermeiro informado sobre qualquer anormalidade que ocorra na unidade;
  • Solicitar medicamentos e materiais quando necessário;
  • Fazer a devolução de pertences imediatamente após alta, óbito ou transferência para outros setores (na ausência do assistente de unidade), de acordo com o protocolo;
  • Participar da passagem de plantão ao início e ao final do seu período de trabalho, na beira do leito;
  • Participar dos programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento de seu setor e da Instituição;
  • Entre outras funções pertinentes ao cargo.

Pré-Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Curso Técnico em Enfermagem;
  • COREN ativo;
  • Conhecimento Básico de Informática (Pacote Office);
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano no cargo.

Benefícios

  • Vale alimentação;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Funeral;
  • Convênio com faculdade;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • TotalPass (opcional);
  • ZenClub (opcional);
  • Plano odontológico (opcional);
  • Plano de saúde (opcional).

Horas de Trabalho e Salário

Carga horária: 07:00 AS 19:00 - 12x60h (30 horas semanais). Salário: R$ 2.560,55 + R$ 324,20 (insalubridade).

Local de Trabalho

Ilha do Governador.

Competências Individuais

  • Organização;
  • Ética;
  • Atenção;
  • Proatividade;
  • Iniciativa.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job SummaryThe Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia’s headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials.Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required.Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects.Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines.Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies.Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation.In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required.Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials.Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable.Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactivelyAssumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions.Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable.Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product.Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead.Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans.Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation.Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report.Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as requiredWork with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conductServe as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicatedParticipates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives.Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed.Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and ExperienceBachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.).Experience managing clinical project team personnel.Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies.Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations.Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports.Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process.Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US.Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members.Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects.Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus.Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity.Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and AbilitiesStrong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment.Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers.Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate.Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment.Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment.Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.)..Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers.Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business.Must be fluent in English

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and data reconciliation activities Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes Provide post-go-live support and stabilization SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities Experience with SAP Fiori applications and title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description: About the Role: CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support, Cyber Threat Takedown Operations, and Security Event Analysis. You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence. This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity. Key Responsibilities: 1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1 Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone. Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools. Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision. Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues. Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries. Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection. 2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms. Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST). Why Join Us? Work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and digital risk protection. Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response. Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment. Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)Please upload your CV Resume in English.Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USDAlong with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.Essential Functions- A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.- On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.- User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.- Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.- Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.- Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.- Other duties may be assignedWhat you will bring / QualificationsTo perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.- In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.- Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.- Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform;
ability to collaborateeffectively with development teams on implementation.- Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.- Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.- Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.- Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.- Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.- Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.Education and/or experience- Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.- 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.Core competencies- Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.- Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.- Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.- Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.- Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.- Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.- Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.- Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.Benefits- A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.- The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.- Two weeks of paid vacation per year.- 10 paid days for local holidays.*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

- Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.

- Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
