title: Institutional Relations Manager
description:
Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding. Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes. We are looking for an Institutional Relations Manager to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? - Bachelor’s degree in Law, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration or related fields;
postgraduate degree orMBA will be considered a plus, - Minimum of 8 years of experience in institutional, governmental, or regulatory affairs, preferably within the energy sector (power generation, natural gas, oil & gas, or infrastructure), - Strong knowledge of the Brazilian regulatory environment, especially in the electricity and natural gas sectors, including interaction with entities such as ANEEL, ONS, and MME, - Proven experience in managing relationships with key stakeholders (government, regulators, associations, and institutional partners), - Advanced English (spoken and written), - Strong communication, negotiation, and influencing skills in complex and multicultural environments, - Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret regulatory scenarios and anticipate risks and opportunities, - Leadership skills, project management capabilities, and ability to work cross-functionally, - Ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and handle strategic topics, - High ethical standards and alignment with compliance and corporate governance practices, - Proactive profile with autonomy and ability to develop strategic and innovative solutions. WHAT AWAITS YOU? - Lead and execute KPS Brazil’s institutional and governmental relations strategy, ensuring alignment with business and regulatory objectives, - Develop and maintain strategic relationships with government bodies, regulators, and industry entities, including ANEEL, ONS, MME, IBAMA, and other relevant stakeholders, - Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities, - Proactively represent and defend the company’s interests in public consultations, hearings, and regulatory forums, - Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets), - Structure and implement stakeholder engagement strategies at local, regional, and national levels, including governments, communities, and strategic partners, - Support institutional and contractual negotiations with public authorities and regulatory bodies, ensuring legal compliance and risk mitigation, - Work closely with legal, regulatory, commercial, and operational teams to ensure consistency in the company’s institutional positioning, - Manage institutional crises and sensitive matters, ensuring effective communication and strategic positioning, - Lead the preparation of strategic reports and executive analyses on the regulatory and institutional environment to support senior leadership decision-making, - Represent the company in industry associations, chambers of commerce, and energy sector forums, strengthening KPS’s institutional presence in Brazil, - Ensure compliance with corporate governance, ethics, and compliance guidelines in all institutional interactions. WHAT DO WE OFFER? - Hybrid working model, - One day off on your birthday, - Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance, - Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus, - Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices, - Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy), - Well-being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass, - Professional and personal training and development opportunities, - Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects, - Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity. In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD (Law No. 13,709/2018), we kindly ask you to review our Privacy Notice for detailed information regarding the processing of your personal data.

title: Operador De Usv
description: Sobre a TideWise A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais. Descrição da Vaga Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo. Responsabilidades e Atribuições 1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo) Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais. Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão. Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM. Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões. 2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação. Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões. Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção. Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões. Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações. 3. Manobras e Modos de Operação Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão. Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação. 4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e "quase acidentes"). Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura. Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos). 5. Registros e Evidências Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes. Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução). Requisitos e Qualificações Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+). Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador). Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos). Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio). Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés. Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV). Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico. Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica). Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills) Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos. Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão. Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF). Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade. Benefícios TideWise: Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação e Mobilidade oferecidos no Cartão Caju Benefícios. Adicional de 25% no Vale-Alimentação por filho com idade inferior a 21 anos. Plano de Saúde e Plano Dental Sulamérica sem coparticipação para colaboradores. Seguro de vida. WellHub. Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

title: Coordenador De Planejamento E Controle
description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos. Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento. Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio. Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento. Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável. Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente. Missão do cargo: Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos. Principais Responsabilidades Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
Desenvolver,estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo: Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;
Requisitos técnicos Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
Sólida experiência emPlanejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo: Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);
Diferenciais desejáveis Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
Vivência comindexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro. Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados. Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

title: Freelancer Recruiter
description: A Recruiter is responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring top talent to meet an organization’s staffing needs, ensuring that each hire aligns with both the technical requirements and the cultural values of the company. This role involves proactively sourcing candidates through a variety of channels, including job boards, professional networks, social media platforms, recruitment agencies, industry events, and employee referrals. Once potential candidates are identified, the Recruiter screens applications, conducts initial assessments, and manages interview processes to evaluate skills, experience, and fit. They work closely with hiring managers to define job requirements, craft compelling job descriptions, and establish selection criteria that lead to strong matches. The role extends beyond simply filling positions—it also involves managing the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial contact to offer negotiation and onboarding. This includes coordinating interviews, providing feedback to candidates, ensuring timely communication, and guiding both candidates and hiring teams through each stage of the process. A strong focus on candidate experience is key, as positive interactions contribute to the employer’s brand and long-term talent pipeline. In many cases, Recruiters also track and analyze hiring metrics—such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and source effectiveness—to refine strategies and improve overall recruitment efficiency. They stay informed about labor market trends, competitive compensation data, and evolving recruitment technologies, adapting approaches to remain competitive in attracting top talent. To excel, a Recruiter must combine exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with strategic thinking, organization, and relationship-building capabilities. Their work plays a critical role in shaping the company’s workforce, influencing its ability to grow, innovate, and succeed. title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like‑minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries- In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.- Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean‑climate policy.- As needed, facilitate in‑person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.- Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.Blue Climate Program- Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.- Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.Other duties as assigned by supervisor.WORKING CONDITIONS- Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.- Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.- Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.- Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high‑level policy events.- This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.QUALIFICATIONSRequired- Bachelor’s degree- 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.- Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.- Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.- Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast‑paced, changing environment.- Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.- Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.- Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.- Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.- Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred- Bi‑lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.- Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature‑based solutions- Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.- Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.See all Conservation International Career Opportunities HEREConservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Program Coordinator

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description: About RateGain RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day. Exploring the role RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business. The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond. This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations. title: Sr. Growth Marketing Manager - Remote
description: About UsAt Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to dataFor more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.Why You’re HereYou’ll be the engine behind getting Zyte’s story and brand out into the world. Your mission is to turn content, of all types, into fuel for growth—promoting and repurposing Zyte.Com content, distributing it across our ICP communities and marketing channels, and ensuring Zyte stays top-of-mind for developers, data teams and data buyers.You’re here to:- Amplify and reinforce the Zyte brand as an authority in web scraping.- Drive maximum reach and engagement for Zyte content.- Reach our ICPs where they are, at scale.What You’ll Deliver- Content Amplification: Turn Zyte content into intelligent cross-channel campaigns and ensure it reaches the right audiences.- AI-Powered Execution: Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) to repurpose content at scale.- Channel Identification: Build presence in ecosystems like Reddit, Hackernews, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, X, dev.To, substack, and emerging platforms (which you’ll need to identify).- Social Media & Community: Manage Zyte’s social presence with an eye for authenticity and cutting-edge social plays.- Campaign Velocity: Launch fast, iterative campaigns with tailored messaging per channel—no bloated briefs.Quantitative- New audience growth (traffic, reach, social engagement)- Content engagement (CTR, CVR, downloads, shares)Qualitative- Innovation in AI-driven content repurposing- Speed and creativity of campaign execution- Ability to crack web data professional ecosystems with authentic content- Cross-team collaboration and impact on broader demand gen goalsWho You Are- Technical ICP-Focused: You know what resonates with developers and data professionals—and what falls flat.- Channel Fluent: You know how to break into niche ecosystems with the right tone, content, and delivery.- AI-Native: You use AI as a natural part of your workflow, not an afterthought. We need to see this in your mentality.- Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.- Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.Requirements- 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products- Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills- Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.- (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer toolsTech You’ll work with- HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics- Figma, Notion, Google Workspace- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideationHow We WorkWe move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. Campaigns are built around business goals—not bloated processes. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.As a new Zytan, you will:Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Head Of Legal
description:
About InPlanetInPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive;
the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page hereAbout the RoleWe are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets, requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.- Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations- Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions, from operations to international expansion- Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships- Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities- Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People- Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks- Manage external network of trusted legal advisorsCore working relationships- Directly reporting to the CFO.- Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors- External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodiesContext of the role:- You will join a lean and evolving legal function, with high ownership from day one- Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale- Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)- The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal, depending on scope and impactKey Responsibilities- Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally- Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)- Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts, including:- Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.G. Investment agreements)- Own cross-border legal strategy and execution- Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)- Work closely with tax advisors- Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains, including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets- Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement- Support investor relations from a legal standpoint- Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructureYou can be a Rock-Star if you haveCore Skills & Experience- Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)- 8–15+ years of experience, ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors- Proven experience in:- Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle- Due diligence (legal & regulatory)- Complex contract structuring and negotiation- International contracts and cross-border operations- Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.G., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)- Solid experience with:- Corporate law and governance- Investor relations and strategic partnerships- Fluency in English, with experience working in international environmentsKey Qualities- Business-oriented mindset: understands legal as a driver of growth- Highly relational: strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions- Strategic thinker: connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks- Pragmatic and solution-driven: balances risk with execution speed- High ownership: comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure- Strong institutional presence: capable of representing the company externally- Structured and integrative: able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains- Neutral and sound judgment, especially in complex or sensitive mattersBonus Points (but not essential)- Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets- Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms- Exposure to governance and international structures- Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)- Business and legal experience in Germany- Speaks German- Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SPLiving Our ValuesAt InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.- Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes- Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency- Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate changeBenefits- Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.- Equity to feel like an owner- Home Office Budget- Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).- Personal development budget- Language Programme Monthly Allowance- 40+ days annual leave- The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.- Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!- Laptop to fuel your productivityInPlanet Compensation PhilosophyAt InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.Equal Opportunity StatementBeing an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. title: Especialista Jurídico Sênior
description:
Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil LtdaDomínio Direito EmpresarialTipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)Experiência Mínimo 10 anosContext & EnvironmentA posição atua no mercado brasileiro, caracterizado por um ambiente jurídico e regulatório complexo e em constante evolução. O cargo exige interação e colaboração frequentes com uma ampla gama de partes internas e externas, incluindo clientes internos, escritórios de advocacia, associações do setor, parceiros de joint ventures, fornecedores e autoridades governamentais.Dada a natureza dessas interações, a função demanda fortes habilidades de negociação e a capacidade de se engajar de forma estratégica e eficaz com diferentes públicos.AtividadesPrincipais AtividadesA(o) funcionário(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, tendo em vista a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a melhoria da eficiência energética e para a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.A posição de Especialista Jurídico Sênior é responsável por executar as seguintes atividades, com certo nível de autonomia, em alinhamento com as orientações do Gerente Jurídico e do Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa:1. Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.2. Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.3. Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.4. Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.5. Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.6. Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.7. Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.8. Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.9. Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.10. One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.ResponsabilidadesO Especialista Jurídico Sênior prestará suporte a outras divisões da TEPBR, conforme alocação definida pelo Gerente Jurídico e pelo Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa, bem como elaborará análises sobre temas regulatórios e jurídicos de média-alta complexidade e materialidade, relacionados a atividades, ativos e projetos especiais.O cargo também apoiará a implementação e a observância das regras e regulamentos de Compliance e de HSE aplicáveis. O(a) empregado(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, com foco na proteção da integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.Perfil do CandidatoNível de qualificação: Bacharelado em Direito, com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB).Competências técnicas:Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Estratégia De Redes Sociais - Influência E Produção | Marketing Produtos...
description:
Descrição da vagaSobre a área:A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Atua com as outras áreas de Marketing na conceituação e execução de planos de lançamento e sustentação dos projetos e campanhas alinhado aos objetivos de negócio de cada frente. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.Diversidade:Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.Modelo de trabalho:Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesComo será seu dia a dia:- Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
- Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;
- Atuar em parceria com outras lideranças na concepção, planejamento e gestão de projetos de lançamento e sustentação das marcas;
- Gerenciar o time de Produção, responsável por toda a cadeia de execução: pré-produção, atuação in loco e pós-produção;
- Garantir a entrega de conteúdos originais e coberturas de grandes eventos para os perfis do ecossistema;
- Liderar a gestão orçamentária das campanhas de influência e dos projetos de produção.Requisitos e qualificaçõesDo que você precisa:- Experiência em Marketing de Influência, com sólido conhecimento sobre a creator economy e o mercado de influenciadores, atuando estrategicamente na conexão entre marcas e creators;
- Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;
- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de storytelling, sendo capaz de transformar ideias, informações e dados em narrativas estratégicas, relevantes e criativas para diferentes plataformas;
- Experiência na análisede métricas de redes sociais, utilizando dados e indicadores de performance para embasar tomadas de decisão estratégicas e otimização de resultados;
- Vivência na criação e proposição de soluções criativas, alinhadas às linguagens, tendências e referências das redes sociais, garantindo relevância cultural e engajamento;
- Perfil constantemente atento a novidades, insights e movimentos do mercado, contribuindo para o fortalecimento de um posicionamento de marca ousado, inovador e conectado às transformações digitais;
- Experiência na elaboração de apresentações estratégicas em PowerPoint, com clareza narrativa, organização de informações e foco em objetivos de negócio;
- Conhecimento e uso do Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel, aplicado à análise, organização e acompanhamento de dados e indicadores;
- Vivência na gestão de orçamentos de campanhas e produções, assegurando controle financeiro, eficiência de custos e otimização de recursos;
- Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas, com atuação direta na gestão, engajamento e evolução de equipes;
- Atuação colaborativa, com perfil inquieto, curioso e antenado às constantes transformações do mercado, contribuindo ativamente em ambientes multidisciplinares;
- Comunicação em inglês em nível avançado, com capacidade de conduzir interações profissionais, apresentações e análises no idioma.Conhecimentos que te destacam:- Conhecimento e atuação prévia com agências de influenciadores do mercado.Informações adicionaisPor que vir para Globo:Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos.#J-18808-Ljbffr

RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design. description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level?At Qencode, we're not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we're redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we're shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video.We're looking for aMarketing Coordinatorwho's eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you'll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment.Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit.About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world.
